overturned.reason: Executor recorded FAIL on the theory live UnitPrice 1268.43912 = USD tier 1357.2 x EUR FX 0.9346 (double-applied FX), correct = EUR tier 1248.62. Live re-measurement DISPROVES probe (3): the org's actual active EUR FX is 0.92 (not 0.9346) per CurrencyType and DatedConversionRate, and 0.9346 appears in NO live FX source. Decisively, 1357.2 x 0.92 = 1248.624 = the executor's OWN claimed-correct value -- so if V21 were genuinely FX-multiplying the USD tier, a fresh reprice today (rate 0.92) would produce 1248.62 = a PASS. Instead UnitPrice is frozen at the 0.9346-derived value across 3 fresh reprices and never recomputes, while NetUnitPrice/Base_Price__c degrade non-deterministically (Base reseeded from prior NetUnitPrice) -- the signature of a stale/corrupted line, not a clean V21 computation. The reported +19.82 EUR overcharge is exactly 1357.2 x (0.9346-0.92), the gap between a stale snapshot FX and the current org FX. Branch did fire on valid inputs (probes 1-2 hold), but probe 3 fails: V21 on a fresh reprice with current FX does not produce the wrong number; the wrong number is a frozen stale field a real UI rep would not hit (they'd get 1248.62). Verdict BLOCKED / TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT, not FAIL. If a clean re-seeded EUR Total-Price line still shows USD-tier x FX != native EUR tier on fresh reprice, re-open as PROCEDURE-DEFECT -- that was not demonstrated here.

REFUTED the original FAIL; the catalog expected value is the error. Fresh Force-reprice of the CURRENT active V21 proves all three burden items run AGAINST a defect: (1) data VALID - PBE active/$2800/USD on active parent book, Perpetual product, existing UI-style records, CompletedWithPricing; (2) intended null-safe branch FIRED - reprice isSuccess=true errorResponse=[] (NO NPE) and positive line uncorrupted (TotalLineAmount=14000); (3) V21 did NOT produce a wrong number - it yields Subtotal=ALE=11200 = 14000 + (2800 x -1), the arithmetically CORRECT result for a Qty=-1 credit. The catalog's expected 'negative excluded, ALE=14000' is wrong: AllLinesNullSafeFilter gates only ListContainer11's per-line ItemTotalAdjustmentAmount NPE guard, not the header rollup; and Quote.ALE__c is a Formula(Number) literally = 'Subtotal' (CustomField 00NWC000003d66a2AA Metadata.formula='Subtotal' verified live), so no pricing step can exclude a correctly-priced negative line from ALE. Negative line prices via base NetUnitPrice x Quantity (CancelNetUnitPrice__c=null, standard catalog path - no new branch). SC-3441 intent is exactly that a negative-qty line yields a negative credit rolling into the header. Both real assertions (no NPE; positive line uncorrupted) PASS. Not a data issue, not a headless $0 artifact, not a procedure defect. EXPECTATION-ERROR -> PASS. Agrees with run3 executor, disagrees with original FAIL.
